$schema: one entry per logical Garmin Connect operation this project depends on. method+path from live probing or from decompiling the Garmin Connect Android client (v5.29, 2026-09). lastVerified is when the status below was actually observed. observedStatus is what came back, not what is hoped for.

auth.notes: OAuth1-signed request, returns an OAuth2 access token valid ~24h (observed expires_in=88227s). This is the only working auth path since Garmin blocked scripted SSO login behind Cloudflare in March 2026 -- see garth's deprecation. Verified by live use in tools/lib/garmin-auth.mjs.

read.notes: Legacy/general daily summary. Exposes consumedKilocalories, remainingKilocalories, activeKilocalories, bmrKilocalories -- but consumedKilocalories was observed null even on a date where nutrition-service/food/logs/{date} showed real logged food. Do not treat this as the nutrition source of truth; it appears to be a separate, disconnected field. Kept only as a control route to confirm auth is alive.

FatSecret- and Garmin-sourced results. Czech terms return results. Parameter name was discovered from a 400 error body naming 'searchFood.arg0.searchExpression'. Response: { results: [{ type, foodMetaData: { foodId, foodName, foodType, source (FATSECRET|GARMIN), regionCode, languageCode }, nutritionContents: [{ servingId, servingUnit, numberOfUnits, calories, carbs, protein, fat, fiber, sugar, saturatedFat, monounsaturatedFat, polyunsaturatedFat, cholesterol, sodium, potassium, vitaminA, vitaminC, calcium, iron, unitHasServing }], isFavorite, isRecent, servingQty, logTimestamp }], moreDataAvailable }. regionCode/languageCode are response-only, not accepted as query filters (tried, got 400).
String literal found in decompiled client (classes9.dex). Not yet exercised live -- exact query param and trailing-slash requirement unconfirmed.

Route confirmed to exist: no-param request returns 400 naming 'getFoodByBarCode.arg1' and 'barCode query parameter must be provided'. A real-looking EAN-13 (8594001020010) returned 404, which is 'no product for this barcode', not 'route missing' -- distinguishable because the no-param case was 400, not 404. Needs a barcode known to exist in the DB to confirm the success payload shape.

String literal found in decompiled client. Write-shaped (image upload), not exercised. Out of scope for this project's MVP -- app's own VisionKit barcode scan covers the barcode case; AI photo recognition is a stretch goal.

THE CORRECT read route -- plural 'logs', not 'log'. The vault's scripts/lib/garmin.mjs calls the singular '/nutrition-service/food/log/date/{date}', which 404s; that one-letter difference is why getNutritionLog() has silently returned null since it was written. Confirmed live with real data present on this account for 2026-09-14. Response top level: { mealDate, dayStartTime, dayEndTime, dailyViewType, dailyNutritionGoals: { calories, adjustedCalories, carbs, adjustedCarbs, fat, adjustedFat, protein, adjustedProtein }, dailyNutritionContent: { calories, carbs, fat, protein, caloriesPercentage }, mealDetails: [{ meal: { mealId, mealIndex, mealName (BREAKFAST/...), displayOrder, startTime, endTime, goals, editable, translated }, mealNutritionContent, mealNutritionGoals, loggedFoods: [{ id, logId, logTimestamp, logSource (GCM observed), logCategory (REGULAR_LOG observed), servingQty, foodMetaData, nutritionContent, isFavorite, mealId, customMealId, mealTime, foodInactive, type }] }], loggedFoodsWithServingSizes: [...] }. dayStartTime/dayEndTime were 04:00:00/17:00:00 on the observed day -- the nutrition 'day' window is configurable and is NOT simple local midnight-to-midnight; account for this when reading 'today'.

write.notes: Inferred from the decompiled client's FoodLogRequestDTO (Kotlin toString fragments: 'FoodLogRequestDTO(date=', ', mealType=', ', foodId=', ', servingId='). Field set is a reasonable inference from the read shape's loggedFoods items (foodId, servingId, numberOfUnits or servingQty, mealId/mealType, date) but is UNCONFIRMED until a real write is attempted -- see add-garmin-auth-and-sync task 11.4. Per this project's rules, no automated tool sends this request; the first attempt is a deliberate, human-supervised one-off against a clearly identifiable test food.

DTO FoodLogQuickAddRequestDTO(date=...) found in decompiled client. Likely takes a foodId/servingId already known to be a favorite or recent, without needing full serving/macro detail -- a strong candidate for what a Control's quick-pick tap actually calls.
DTOs BulkFoodLogRequestDTO(action=...) and BulkFoodLogItemDTO(logId=...) found in decompiled client. Out of scope for MVP -- single-entry create covers this project's use case.

DTO DeleteFoodRequestDTO(logIds=...) found in decompiled client -- takes a list of logId values (the same logId field observed on read, a hex string without dashes, not the same as foodId). Confirms delete-by-logId is the mechanism reconciliation (garmin-sync duplicate cleanup) should use.

unresolved: Whether an entitlement check (Connect+) gates any of the write routes -- no 402/403 has been observed anywhere, but nothing has been written by this project's own tooling either, so absence of a paywall error is not proof one doesn't exist.

Exact JSON body Content-Type and required fields for createFoodLogEntry -- decompiling gave field NAMES via Kotlin toString() fragments, not their order or which are optional, since dex string pools are alphabetically sorted and destroy source order.
Whether logSource and logCategory are client-supplied on write or server-assigned (observed as 'GCM' and 'REGULAR_LOG' on reads, suggesting server-assigned, but unconfirmed).
